HEROIC (formerly stylized as Heroic) is a Norwegian esports organization located in Oslo. They are best-known for their achievements in Counter-Strike, in which they have competed in since 2016. They formerly competed in Dota 2, Fortnite, PUBG Mobile, Sim Racing, Rainbow Six, PUBG and Rocket League.
